menu: Tensura Compass replaces the retired reincarnation compass/menu crystal.

horns.skill: Each hotbar slot stores an independent skill assignment.
horns.magic: Each hotbar slot stores an independent magic assignment.
horns.naming: Names mobs directly and offers player naming with target consent.

crafting: Dedicated placeable Tensura Crafting Table with recipe and forge/alchemy/kiln/mining/spellbinding menu.
resources: HP is read from actual health; MP, AP and SP are consumed by the appropriate spell/skill categories; EP is recalculated from resource pools.
hud: 18-segment left-anchored bars; enlarged HUD panel; three passive skill slots.
skills: Great Sage, Raphael and Ciel remain Unique Skills; Raphael is a passive loadout skill; passive skills support equip and unequip.
reset_scroll: Character Reset Scroll opens confirmation and resets race/progression while preserving inventory and gear.
elemental_spirits: Eight summonable elemental spirit entities with rank-based contract costs and source-derived visual reuse.
armor_ep: Equipment stores EP and advances grade over time; armor/weapon self-repair retained.
bows: Bow/crossbow item definitions use Bedrock shooter components and arrow ammunition.
bosses: Boss health increased to thousands/hundreds of thousands/millions; boss loot tables and scripted drops are Tensura items only.

dimensions.Great Spirit Labyrinth: End approximation with ten Java-derived structure segments and guardian/hound

mobile: Uses Bedrock Script API and item-based UI; no chat command workflow for menu, skills, magic or naming.
